card_description_ammorefill:
Refills energy of target ally. The amount depends on the targets stage.
  Stage I - %(energy_amount_stage_1_percentage)
  Stage II - %(energy_amount_stage_2_percentage)
  Stage III - %(energy_amount_stage_3_percentage)
  Legendary - %(energy_amount_legendary_percentage)
card_description_cataclysm: Divine. Annihilates all units and buildings (except base buildings) in the target area. Can only be cast within the Nexus summoning zone.
card_description_earthquake: Shakes the earth every %(wave_cooldown) seconds for %(wave_count) waves each dealing %(damage_amount) siege splash damage to all enemies in target area. All enemy units are stunned each wave.
card_description_echoesofthefuture: Doubles your income for the next %(duration) seconds. Afterwards you don't get any income for %(duration) seconds.
card_description_energyrift: Creates an energy rift over an allied building, which shoots at enemy targets dealing %(damage_amount) damage per hit. Lasts for %(duration) seconds or until the building is destroyed.
card_description_entanglingroots: Roots up to %(target_count) enemy units in target area.
card_description_evolveoracle: Evolves an allied Sapling into an Oracle. It´s summoned with %(initial_health_percentage) of its maximum health.
card_description_evolvethistle: Evolves up to %(target_count) allied Saplings into Thistles.
card_description_factoryreset: Up to %(target_count) non-legendary non-base targets lose all applied effects. Moreover their health, energy and building timer are reset to their initial values.
card_description_fluxfield: Creates a domain. Enemies in the target area are silenced. Allied units entering the domain receive Enchantment: Flux (Has %(charge_amount) charges. Domains disappear when no charges are left).
card_description_freeze: Freezes up to %(target_count) enemy units in target area.
card_description_frenzy: Target allied unit gains Enchantment: Frenzy.
card_description_frostspear: Freezes target enemy (halved duration for base buildings). Afterwards it shoots %(shard_count) ice shards at random nearby enemies dealing %(damage_amount) damage each.
card_description_giantgrowth: Target allied unit gains Enchantment: Growth.
card_description_hailofarrows: Fires %(initial_wave_count) waves of arrows each dealing %(damage_amount) damage to all enemies in target area. An additional wave of arrows is fired for each nearby Archer.
card_description_healinggarden: Creates a domain. Allies in the target area gain %(energy_amount) energy every %(energy_cooldown) seconds (does not stack). Allied units entering the domain receive Enchantment: Health (Has %(charge_amount) charges. Domains disappear when no charges are left).
card_description_inversegravity: Up to %(target_count) non-legendary units or gadgets gain lifted (for ground targets) or grounded (for flying targets).
card_description_lanenode: If only units of any one team are in range of the capture point, it is captured and will be fortified with a light guard tower. If a guard tower is destroyed, it can be recaptured after 60 seconds.
card_description_lightpulse: Stuns (small range, up to %(target_count_stun) targets) and blinds (great range, up to %(target_count_blind) targets) enemy units in target area.
card_description_ontheedge: Creates a domain. Enemies in the target area have their auto attack range reduced by %(range_reduction). Allied units entering the domain receive Enchantment: Grievous Wounds (Has %(charge_amount) charges. Domains disappear when no charges are left).
card_description_orbitalstrike: Target enemy (except base buildings) gets burned by an orbital laser dealing %(primary_damage_amount) damage every %(primary_damage_cooldown) seconds. While the laser is active, surrounding enemies are hit randomly by orbital bombardment dealing %(splash_damage_amount) splash damage every %(splash_damage_cooldown) seconds. The laser is active for %(duration) seconds or until the target dies.
card_description_petrify: Up to %(target_count) non-basebuilding targets in target area are petrified.
card_description_promiseoflife: Creates a domain. Allied units in the target area are protected and immune to status effects (Buildings are immune to status effects as well). Whenever a unit´s protection is triggered, the domain depletes one charge (Has %(charge_amount) charges. domains disappear when no charges are left).
card_description_relocate:
Teleports up to %(target_count) allies to another target location. Recently teleported targets can't be teleported for %(cooldown) seconds. Buildings are prioritized, healed and replenished after reappearing based on their stage.
  Stage I - %(heal_stage_1) health and %(energy_stage_1) energy
  Stage II - %(heal_stage_2) health and %(energy_stage_2) energy
  Stage III - %(heal_stage_3) health and %(energy_stage_3) energy
card_description_ripoutsoul: Banishes up to %(target_count) units in target area and deals damage equal %(damage_amount_percentage) of their maximum health.
card_description_saplingcharge: Summons %(initial_sapling_amount) Saplings on cast and additionally %(wave_sapling_amount) Saplings for %(wave_count) Waves.
card_description_shatterice: Deals %(damage_amount) damage to all frozen enemies in target area (%(damage_amount_buildings) to Buildings).
card_description_shieldsup: Up to %(target_count) allied units in target area gain a shieldblock.
card_description_solarflare: Heals target allied unit by %(primary_heal_amount) and creates an aura that heals other nearby units by %(splash_heal_amount) (%(duration) seconds duration). Can overheal.
card_description_stonecircle: Creates a domain. Allies in the target area receive only %(damage_reduction_percentage) damage from spells and abilities. Allied melee units entering the domain receive Enchantment: Stonefist (Has %(charge_amount) charges. Domains disappear when no charges are left).
card_description_surgeoflight:
If the target unit is an ally, it is healed for %(heal_amount) (can overheal) and this spell gains %(counter_gained_amount) light counter.
If the target unit is an enemy, it receives damage equal to the light counters times %(damage_amount) consuming all light counters.
card_short_description_cataclysm: Divine. Annihilates all units and buildings in the target area.
card_short_description_earthquake: Legendary. Stuns units and deals siege splash damage in waves in target area.
card_short_description_echoesofthefuture: Doubles your income for the next %(duration) seconds. Afterwards you don't get any income for %(duration) seconds.
card_short_description_energyrift: Creates a shooting energy rift over an allied building.
card_short_description_evolveoracle: Evolves an allied Sapling into an Oracle.
card_short_description_evolvethistle: Evolves up to %(target_count) allied Saplings into Thistles.
card_short_description_factoryreset: Resets health and energy of up to %(target_count) targets and removes all applied effects.
card_short_description_fluxfield: Creates a domain that silences enemy targets and gives allies Enchantment: Flux.
card_short_description_frenzy: Target allied unit gains Enchantment: Frenzy, increasing its attack speed.
card_short_description_frostspear: Freezes the target and let it shoot ice shards.
card_short_description_giantgrowth: Target allied unit gains Enchantment: Growth, increasing its maximum health and regenerating it.
card_short_description_hailofarrows: Fires waves of arrows onto target area. Nearby Archers enhance this effect.
card_short_description_healinggarden: Creates a domain that replenishes allied units energy and gives them Enchantment: Health.
card_short_description_inversegravity: Up to %(target_count) ground targets are lifted and flying targets are grounded.
card_short_description_lightpulse: Stuns and blinds up to %(target_count_blind) target enemy units.
card_short_description_ontheedge: Creates a domain that reduces enemy range and gives allies Enchantment: Grievous Wounds.
card_short_description_orbitalstrike: Target enemy is burned by a laser while bombarding surrounding enemies.
card_short_description_permafrost: Target unit is frozen and gains Enchantment: Harden, modifying its health and armor class.
card_short_description_promiseoflife: Creates a domain that prevents allied units from dying and grants immunity to status effects.
card_short_description_relocate: Teleports up to %(target_count) allies to another location. Buildings are healed and replenished.
card_short_description_saplingcharge: Legendary. Summons hordes of Saplings in target area.
card_short_description_shatterice: Deals massive damage to frozen enemies.
card_short_description_shieldsup: Gives %(target_count) allied units in target area a shieldblock.
card_short_description_solarflare: Heals target allied unit and provides a healing aura. Can overheal.
card_short_description_stonecircle: Creates a domain that lower spell and ability damage and gives allies Enchantment: Stonefist.
card_short_description_surgeoflight: Heals target allied unit gaining charges or damages target enemy unit consuming charges. Can Overheal.
effect_annihilated_description: Annihilated units are removed from the game instantly and don't trigger any effects.
effect_banished_description: Banished (status effect) units can´t move, be attacked or targeted by spells for 10 seconds. Moreover they don't affect capture points. Recently banished units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_bleeding_description: Bleeding (status effect) units receive 0.5% of their maximum health as damage every second (stacks up to 20 times). Moreover while having at least 1 stack any received heal is reduced by 40%. This effect lasts for 10 seconds.
effect_blinded_description: Blinded (status effect) units miss 50% of their attacks for 12 seconds. Recently blinded units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_domain_description: Domains are target areas with certain effects. You can control up to 3 at a time. When creating a fourth domain, the first will disappear.
effect_enchanted_description: Enchantments of the same name can only be received once per unit.
effect_frozen_description: Frozen (status effect) units are incapacitated for 9 seconds. Recently frozen units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_grounded_description: Grounded (status effect) units lose flying and can't move. Recently grounded units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_guarded_description: Protected units are saved from dying once. Their health is set to 1 instead and they become invincible for 2 seconds. Recently protected units are immune to this effect for 60 seconds.
effect_lifted_description: Lifted (status effect) units gain flying and can't move. Recently lifted units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_missile_description: Missiles deal 54 splash damage and have Predator: Flying (200% damage to flying and monumental targets).
effect_overheal_description: Overheal exceeding a unit´s maximum health is saved as a shield. The maximum shield amount is 200% of the unit´s maximum health.
effect_petrified_description: Petrified (status effect) targets are incapacitated for 12 seconds. They regenerate 10 health each second. Can overheal. Recently petrified targets are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_rescued_description: Rescued units are teleported to your nexus. Their health is set to 10 and all status effects are removed. This effect can only occur once per unit.
effect_rooted_description: Rooted (status effect) units can´t move for 12 seconds and receive 1.5 damage per second. Recently rooted units are immune to this effect for 10 seconds.
effect_sapling_description: Saplings are tiny creatures with 2 health and are time limited. Once enchanted they flourish, increasing their health by 50 and living indefinitely.
effect_shieldblock_description: Shieldblock prevents the next incoming damage that exceeds 10. Shieldblocks do not stack.
effect_silenced_description: Silenced (status effect) units can´t use abilities which consume energy.
effect_stateeffect_description: Status effects: banished, bleeding, blinded, frozen, grounded, lifted, petrified, rooted, silenced, stunned.
effect_stealthed_description: Stealthed units can't be targeted by enemies and don't affect capture points.
effect_stunned_description: Stunned (status effect) units are incapacitated for 3 seconds.
effect_summoningsickness_description: Summoning sickness affects units right after they were summoned. They are incapacitated (1 seconds duration).
effect_timed_description: Time limited units die after 17 seconds. This limit is removed if this unit receives an enchantment.
unitability_hint_activearmor: Whenever this unit gets damaged it shoots a projectile at a random enemy dealing %(damage_amount) damage. If a projectile has been shot this unit receives additionally %(self_damage_amount) damage.
unitability_hint_ammotransfer: Transfers %(energy_amount) energy to another nearby allied target. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_ancientwisdom: Whenever this unit gains an enchantment, its health is permanently increased by %(health_bonus).
unitability_hint_antiair: Deals %(primary_damage_amount_percentage) damage to flying or monumental targets.
unitability_hint_barkboost: Absorbs nearby Saplings. Absorbed Saplings increase this unit´s health by %(health_amount). Can absorb up to %(absorb_cap) Saplings. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_biggamehunter: Always attacks the enemy with the highest maximum health in range.
unitability_hint_breachingcharge: If this unit gets near to an enemy building it explodes dealing %(damage_amount) (plus %(damage_amount_per_energy) for each carried energy) splash siege damage around it.
unitability_hint_cleave: Attacks all units in a cone in front of it.
unitability_hint_cloakground: As long as there is no enemy on the same height nearby and this unit is not affected by a status effect, this unit is stealthed.
unitability_hint_crystalartillery: Attacks buildings with a long range attack that deals %(damage_amount) siege damage. Needs to be charged for %(charge_duration) seconds before firing. If this unit is caught in a melee fight it loses all its charges.
unitability_hint_crystalpower: Gives nearby allied units Crystal Power. Crystal Power adds a secondary attack that targets a unit behind the actual target.
unitability_hint_crystalspeed: Increases the attack speed of nearby allied units by %(attack_speed_bonus_percentage). (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown) When the ally moves out of range or this unit is incapacitated the effect ends.
unitability_hint_dampingshield: This unit gets only %(damage_reduction_percentage) damage from splash damage sources.
unitability_hint_deathrattlebentbow: Whenever this unit dies, it shoots an arrow at a random nearby enemy.
unitability_hint_deathrattleblast: Whenever this unit dies, it launches a projectile for each %(energy_cost) energy it has at a random nearby enemy building dealing %(damage_amount) siege damage.
unitability_hint_deathrattlefrostexplosi: Whenever this unit dies, all nearby enemy units are frozen.
unitability_hint_deathrattlesouldonor: Whenever this unit dies, it transfers its energy to random friendly units nearby.
unitability_hint_deathrattlesporefield: Whenever this unit dies, a small patch of spores is created that regenerates allied units (%(heal_amount) health per second, can't be stacked). Enemy flying units entering this area are grounded (lasts for %(duration) seconds).
unitability_hint_debutasteroid: When this unit enters the battlefield, it deals %(damage_amount) splash damage to all enemies in the impact zone.
unitability_hint_debuticyprison: Enters the battlefield perma frozen. All incoming damage is reduced by %(damage_reduction_percentage) and Vecra continuously loses health. After dropping below %(break_threshold_percentage) health, she breaks free and freezes nearby enemies. If they were already frozen they receive %(break_shatter_damage) damage instead.
unitability_hint_debutinsidious: Enters the battlefield enchanted with Enchantment: Grievous Wounds.
unitability_hint_debutrupture: Enters the battlefield moving underground, untargetable for the enemy. If an enemy unit comes into range, this unit breaks free dealing %(damage_amount) splash damage to nearby enemy units.
unitability_hint_debutsoulvortex: When this unit enters the battlefield, all nearby units are banished. Tyrus generates %(energy_amount) energy per affected unit.
unitability_hint_debutstarfall: When this unit enters the battlefield, it instantly annihilates all non-legendary units and buildings in the impact zone.
unitability_hint_debutstun: When this unit enters the battlefield, all nearby enemy units are stunned.
unitability_hint_depletingbounce: Attacks bounce and hit up to %(target_count) random targets. Each hit reduces the damage of the shot by the dealt damage and stops it when the damage is depleted.
unitability_hint_dragonpunch: Whenever this unit attacks another unit with less current health, that unit is stunned and receives %(damage_bonus) damage. If the target´s current health is less than %(annihilate_threshold_percentage) of the Monk´s current health, it is annihilated instead.
unitability_hint_enchantmentarmor:
Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to enchant a nearby allied unit.
Initial effect: Target is healed for %(heal_amount) (can overheal).
Permanent effect: Target´s armor class is increased by %(armor_increase).
unitability_hint_enchantmentflux:
Initial effect: Replenishes %(energy_regeneration_amount) energy every %(energy_regeneration_cooldown) seconds until %(energy_regeneration_cap) energy is replenished in total.
Permanent effect: Maximum energy is increased by %(energy_cap_increase), but current energy remains the same.
unitability_hint_enchantmentfrenzy:
Initial effect (%(duration) seconds duration): Attack speed is increased to %(attack_speed_bonus_percentage) (%(attack_speed_bonus_ranged_percentage) for ranged) and all status effects are removed once.
If the target is melee, it recovers %(heal_amount) health per attack.
If the target is ranged, it can attack %(additional_target_count) additional target.
Permanent: Immunity to status effects.
unitability_hint_enchantmentgrievouswoun: Permanent effect: Every unit dealt damage gains bleeding. If it is already bleeding, the duration is reset. (%(cooldown) second cooldown)
unitability_hint_enchantmentgrowth:
Initial effect (%(duration) seconds duration): Regenerates %(heal_amount_percentage) maximum health per second.
Permanent effect: Maximum health is increased by %(health_amount).
unitability_hint_enchantmenthealth: Permanent effect: Health is increased by %(health_amount_percentage) of the unit´s current maximum health plus %(health_amount).
unitability_hint_enchantmentstonefist: Permanent effect: Increases the auto attack damage by %(damage_increase).
unitability_hint_enchantmentstrength:
Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to enchant a nearby allied unit.
Permanent effect: Target´s health is increased by %(health_bonus), and its attack damage by %(damage_bonus) (%(damage_bonus_surefire) for units with surefire).
unitability_hint_energyinfusion: Whenever this unit is healed, it gains %(energy_per_health) energy per %(health_amount) health received. Whenever this unit is enchanted, it gains %(energy_on_enchant) energy.
unitability_hint_energyregenerationlanet:
Generates %(charge_amount) crystal ammunition.
Stone: (%(cooldown_league_1) seconds cooldown)
Bronze: (%(cooldown_league_2) seconds cooldown)
Silver: (%(cooldown_league_3) seconds cooldown)
Gold: (%(cooldown_league_4) seconds cooldown)
Crystal: (%(cooldown_league_5) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_epic: Divine cards can only be cast once each match and you can only have one of them in your deck. Moreover they cost always the maximum mana of the current stage and use up all charges, which won't recharge.
unitability_hint_evasion: Has a %(evasion_percentage) chance to evade incoming attacks (except spells and splash damage).
unitability_hint_flourish: This unit´s time limit is removed and its health is increased by %(health_amount) once it receives an enchantment. (One time effect)
unitability_hint_flying: Can only be attacked by ranged or flying enemies.
unitability_hint_frostnova: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to freeze an enemy unit. Also deals %(main_target_damage) damage (+%(main_target_splashdamage) splash damage) to the target and %(splash_damage) splash damage to other nearby enemy units. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_fury: Whenever this unit attacks a target with full health, it performs its next attack immediately.
unitability_hint_groundonly: Can only fight targets at the same height. Ground to ground or air to air.
unitability_hint_hailofstones: If this unit has no current targets nearby, it throws stones at buildings over a long distance (%(damage_reduction_percentage) reduced damage).
unitability_hint_haste: Does not suffer from summoning sickness.
unitability_hint_heavilyarmed: Has a rift cannon that annihilates non-legendary enemies instantly, two long-range missile launchers with limited ammunition and four directed gatling turrets.
unitability_hint_homeland: Whenever a nearby allied non-legendary unit dies it is rescued instead.
unitability_hint_inductionenergy: Whenever an allied spell is cast nearby this unit it replenishes %(energy_amount) energy.
unitability_hint_inductionrepair: Whenever an allied spell is cast nearby this unit heals %(heal_amount_percentage) of its maximum health.
unitability_hint_innerfirebounce: As long as this unit has at least %(base_health) health, its attacks bounce and hit up to %(target_count) additional targets (bounces deal %(damage_reduction_percentage) reduced damage).
unitability_hint_intensify: Attacks with a continuous beam that increases its damage every %(cooldown) seconds by %(damage_increase_percentage). (max %(cap) times)
unitability_hint_juggernaut: Movement speed of this unit is halved and it ignores unit collision.
unitability_hint_lanetowerupgrade: This tower gets tougher and deals more damage through the 3 stages of a match.
unitability_hint_lazor: This unit shoots a laser dealing splash damage to all enemies in a line.
unitability_hint_legendary: Each player can only have one legendary active at a time. Legendary units are immune to status effects.
unitability_hint_lightgrenades: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to boost its attack increasing the splash radius and stunning and blinding all enemies hit.
unitability_hint_lightovercharge: The projectile of this unit heals up to %(target_count) allied units it passes over for %(heal_amount) health.
unitability_hint_lightwave: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to deal %(damage_amount) splash damage to all nearby enemy units and heal all nearby allied units by %(heal_amount) (This effect can overheal).
unitability_hint_limitedgadget: You can control up to %(gadget_limit) gadgets on the battlefield at a time. Placing a %(gadget_limit_exceeded)th gadget destroys the first.
unitability_hint_lotharaura: This unit takes %(redirected_damage_percentage) of all the damage nearby allied units would receive.
unitability_hint_massivestomp: Deals %(damage_amount_percentage) of this unit´s current health as additional damage on each attack.
unitability_hint_mercilessfrozen: Deals %(primary_damage_amount_percentage) damage to frozen units and %(secondary_damage_amount_percentage) to units affected by other status effects.
unitability_hint_missilelauncher: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to launch a missile at a random enemy target. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_monarchoffrost: Continuously drains %(damage_amount) health per second from nearby frozen enemies, regenerating itself for %(heal_amount_percentage) of the amount.
unitability_hint_monumental: This entity is very tall and counts as ground and flying unit simultaneously.
unitability_hint_multishot2: Can attack up to %(target_count) enemies at once.
unitability_hint_multishot3: Can attack up to %(target_count) enemies at once.
unitability_hint_nexusbuster1: Shoots at the enemy nexus as long as it doesn‘t have any enemies in range (%(damage_amount) damage, %(cooldown) seconds cooldown). This ability is activated %(activation_cooldown) minutes after the match started.
unitability_hint_nexusupgrade: At the next stage the Nexus becomes tougher and deals more damage.
unitability_hint_nothoming: The projectile of this unit flies in an arc to the targets original location, dealing splash damage at the point of impact. If this unit is flying the range is increased by %(range_amount).
unitability_hint_permafrost:
Initial effect: Freezes target unit.
Permanent effect: If target unit is an ally, it gains %(ally_health_amount) health. If it´s an enemy, its health is reduced by %(enemy_health_reduction_amount). This unit gains heavy armor while frozen.
unitability_hint_primarytarget: As the Nexus is destroyed the team owning it loses the match.
unitability_hint_primarytargetpve: If you defeat this unit your team will win!
unitability_hint_purifyingpotion: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to cleanse all status effects of a nearby ally and makes it immune against status effects. Each unit can drink only one potion.
unitability_hint_rangeaura: Nearby ranged allies increase the range of their auto attacks. Buildings by %(range_increase_buildings) and units by %(range_increase_units).
unitability_hint_reflectiveshield: Nearby allied units reflect ranged attacks (except from base buildings and units with Surefire). After being hit by such an attack it reflects back to the attacker dealing %(reflected_damage_percentage) of its damage. Each reflection deals %(self_damage_amount) damage to Echo Projector.
unitability_hint_relentlessfrozen: Deals %(primary_damage_amount_percentage) damage to frozen units and %(secondary_damage_amount_percentage) to units affected by other status effects.
unitability_hint_relentlessrooted: Deals %(primary_damage_amount_percentage) damage to rooted units and %(secondary_damage_amount_percentage) to units affected by other status effects.
unitability_hint_relentlessstunned: Deals %(primary_damage_amount_percentage) damage to stunned units and %(secondary_damage_amount_percentage) to units affected by other status effects.
unitability_hint_rootbraid: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to root the farthest away enemy in range.
unitability_hint_rootnetwork: Whenever this unit deals damage, rooted enemies near the target take %(damage_amount) splash damage as well.
unitability_hint_searchingfire: This unit deals additionally %(damage_amount) splash damage to its target and to enemies near its target.
unitability_hint_shieldblock: Gains a shieldblock every %(cooldown) seconds (does stack with shieldblocks of other sources).
unitability_hint_shieldoverload: After being damaged this unit becomes invincible for %(duration) seconds. Can only be triggered while this unit is able to act.  (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_souldonor: Transfers %(energy_amount) energy to a nearby ally. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_soulgatherer: Whenever a unit dies, a nearby allied Soulgatherer can collect its soul and convert it into %(energy_amount) energy. If there are no friendly Soulgatherers nearby, an enemy Soulgatherer can collect it.
unitability_hint_soulgathererreaper: Whenever this unit gains %(energy_amount) energy, its health is permanently increased by %(health_amount).
unitability_hint_soulgatherersoularmor: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to block the damage of an incoming attack.
unitability_hint_soulgatherersummonfrost: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to summon a Frostgoyle. It gains Time-Limited.
unitability_hint_soulgathererundying: As long as this unit has energy, it's saved from dying once and fully healed instead. Once this effect triggers, it becomes immune to healing and dies after %(duration) seconds.
unitability_hint_soulundertow: Banishes up to %(target_count) nearby units and generates %(energy_amount) energy per affected unit. Targets friendly units if no enemies are nearby. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_soulvortex: Annihilates an enemy unit with less than %(health_threshold) health in a giant radius and extracts its soul. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_spellimmune: Can't be targeted by enemy spells and takes no damage from spells.
unitability_hint_splash: Enemies near the target take damage as well.
unitability_hint_splash_lanetower1: Enemies near the target take %(damage_amount) splash damage.
unitability_hint_splash_nexus1: Enemies near the target take %(damage_amount) splash damage.
unitability_hint_splinter: Whenever this unit receives %(damage_threshold) damage by a single attack a Granite Scout is spawned. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_stationary: Counts as building and unit at the same time.
unitability_hint_statusabsorb: Whenever this unit is affected by a certain status effect for the first time, it permanently increases its health by %(health_amount).
unitability_hint_statuscopy: Whenever this unit attacks, it copies all status effects of its target.
unitability_hint_statusmirror: Whenever this unit is attacked, it copies all of its status effects to the attacker. (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_steadyaim: While not moving, this unit gradually increases its attack range up to a maximum of %(range_increase) (over %(duration) seconds). This bonus is lost upon moving.
unitability_hint_supreme:
Whenever this card is played Atlas gains %(module_gain) module counter up to %(module_cap). For each module counter after the first one he gains %(health_amount) health. Moreover the armor type will be set to:
%(armor_level_unarmored) - Unarmored
%(armor_level_light) - Light
%(armor_level_medium) - Medium
%(armor_level_heavy) - Heavy
unitability_hint_teleportstrike: Consumes %(energy_cost) energy to teleport to a nearby random enemy target dealing %(damage_amount) damage to it.  (%(cooldown) seconds cooldown)
unitability_hint_timedlife: Dies after %(duration) seconds. Effect is removed if this unit receives an enchantment.
unitability_hint_timedlifebuilding: This building is destroyed after %(duration) seconds.

steam_about_this_game:
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPage.gif[/img]

Enjoy fast-paced, easy-to-pickup tug-of-war strategy. A hybrid of MOBA, tower defense and deckbuilding. Play solo or bring a friend for co-op, collect cards, build your deck and crush your enemies!

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Completely free-to-play
[*]Short, intense 1v1, 2v2 and Co-Op matches
[*]Deck-building
[*]PvE-challenges
[*]Five playable Legions
[*]Dual-color decks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/blue.png[/img]
[i]"Assemble mighty machines and breach through any defenses. Generate energy and materialize behind the enemy lines!"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageCardsBlue.png[/img]
The Blue Legion's main gameplay mechanics feature a variety of [b]energy effects and buildings[/b] that can be used for heavy combos. Defend yourself with a strong defensive line, then teleport it to the enemy so it becomes your attack line. Each spell you cast empowers your troops, enabling them to unleash mighty abilities.


[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/Green.png[/img]
[i]"Lead an army of vivid plants and ancient trees into battle. Root your enemies and drown them in a flood of saplings. Evolve them to become stronger." [/i]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageCardsGreen.png[/img] 
The Green Legion's main gameplay mechanics and combos feature a variety of [b]heal-over-time[/b] effects, [b]rooting[/b] your enemies in place and last but not least, [b]hordes of Saplings[/b] that can be evolved into powerful creatures.  


[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/Black.png[/img]
[i]"Freeze your enemies and drain their life. Creatures from the void gather souls to unleash sinister abilities upon their foes."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageCardsBlack.png[/img]
The Black Legion's main gameplay mechanics and combos feature a variety of [b]freezing spells and abilities[/b], as well as ripping out the souls of enemy units in order to[b] trigger powerful passive abilities[/b].


[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/white.png[/img]
[i]"Command sacred archers and shiny knights accompanied by angelic forces. Raise your shields and stand strong!"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageCardsWhite.png[/img]
The White Legion's main gameplay mechanics and combos feature a variety of [b]healing and shielding spells[/b] that can be targeted at multiple units at once. Overwhelm your opponent with [b]masses of archers and knights[/b] and make them survive to the last minute in order to turn the tide of battle.


[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/colorless.png[/img]
[i]"Awake the ancient legends of long forgotten artifacts and claim the fabled power to obliterate your enemies!"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageCardsColorless.png[/img]
The Crystal Legion’s main gameplay mechanics and combos feature a variety of [b]supporting and stabilizing abilities[/b], while you take control of the battlefield with [b]mighty golems and ancient spells.[/b]


[h2]Is the game Pay-to-win?[/h2]
The game is explicitly not pay-to-win. You can unlock any cards in the game with in-game currencies. Our business model is free-to-play and pay-to-advance-faster, the ONLY things that can only be bought with real money are skins, to help support the game.

[h2]Are there any secrets with exclusive stuff?[/h2]
Sure, you just found one of eight secrets to redeem in the ingame shop: [b]XR0F-7ST3-4MC0-MMUN-1TYX[/b] 🎊
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/SteamPageSecret.png[/img]
